room.belfry.title: Belfry
room.belfry.description: The great [bronze bell](bell) hangs still from an oak beam. A frayed [rope](rope) drops from its wheel.
room.belfry.rung: The great [bronze bell](bell) still sways on its beam, humming. The [rope](rope) twitches against the wheel.
room.bell_tower.title: Bell Tower
room.bell_tower.description: A narrow stair climbs through the dark. Pigeon feathers drift on the steps.
room.bell_tower.rung: A narrow stair climbs through the dark. The walls still tremble with the bell's voice.
detail.bell: Green bronze, cold to the touch. No one has rung it in years.
detail.bell.rung: Green bronze, warm now, still humming under your hand.
detail.rope: Hemp rope, frayed where hands have pulled it.
narration.ring_bell.actor: You haul on the rope. The bell swings, and its voice rolls out over the fen.
narration.ring_bell.observers: The chapel bell rings out over the fen.
